planned_profile.recognizer_identity: new explicit profile; does not replace Parakeet TDT v3

reference_contract.token_comparison: exact token IDs and final text against same-profile streaming reference; no chapter-153 full-context equivalence claim
reference_contract.feature_encoder_tolerance: abs <= 0.001 + 0.001 * abs(reference), all admitted valid elements
reference_contract.audio_partitions: regular 160 ms, single-sample and ragged pushes, exact start/end and short final tail
state_tests: bounded memory independent of utterance duration
duplicate/gap/stale refusal leaves current stream intact
reference_contract.quality: Report WER/CER, first/last-word errors and no-speech false positives on frozen public English corpus; exact reference parity is not a population-accuracy claim. Retain original source/split identities; no multilingual claim.
reference_contract.latency: Measure p50/p99 first partial, per-chunk compute, finalization and memory on named CUDA/Metal hosts; no acceptance number claimed before measurements.

next_gate: Record safe original-weight reference features, encoder/cache and RNNT transitions for this profile before implementing/integrating production streaming.
